labs.notes: The Center for Bioethics is not a PI-led wet/dry-lab department -- it's a scholarly center whose ~170 other listed 'faculty' are affiliates with primary appointments at other HMS departments or entirely different institutions (Tufts, BU, Northeastern Law, University of Hong Kong, Hasselt University, Seton Hall Law, Saint Louis University, etc.), not Center-run labs. Recorded only the Center's own Director as its single contact/lead entry, per CLAUDE.md's policy-center convention (the unit is the organization, the contact is a research lead).
